summary.zh: 荧光笔从左到右划过一句话（跨行也连续），图钉从上方掉下来钉在句尾，落地压扁回弹，评论卡跟着弹出来。
summary.en: A highlighter sweeps a phrase left to right (continuous across line breaks), a pin drops onto the end of it with a squash-and-bounce, then a comment card springs in.

technique.zh: mark 用 linear-gradient 背景，background-size 从 0% 过渡到 100%，配合 box-decoration-break: clone 跨行；图钉位置用 getClientRects() 取最后一行的末尾。
technique.en: The mark has a linear-gradient background animated from 0% to 100% background-size, with box-decoration-break: clone for line wraps; the pin is placed at the end of the last rect from getClientRects().

desc.zh: 图钉下落 + 回弹时长

adapt.zh: 任何一段文字里用 <mark id="hl"> 包住要标的部分就行。
adapt.en: Wrap the target phrase in <mark id="hl"> inside any paragraph.
